@meta.what: Parity-gate fixture for tests/md/test_md_parity.py: the LAMMPS-side JSON that b20mlip.md.parity.check consumes is {frame_id: {"energy": eV, "forces": [[eV/A, eV/A, eV/A], ... natoms]}} (b20mlip.md.parity.collect_parity writes it; keys starting with '@' are ignored). The passing JSON is built in-test from the tiny MACE model's own ASE forces (identical numbers -> passed); this file stores the perturbation that turns a copy into the failing case and the exact maxima the failing check must report.
@meta.source: synthetic bookkeeping (no LAMMPS with pair_style mace exists on the development machine); the ASE side is computed live by the test

expected_passing.note: two MACECalculator instances of one model agree to ~1e-11 (torch summation order), far below tol_f=1e-3 / tol_e=1e-4
